evals.prompt: Create a runnable MATLAB main.m script that reproduces the core Kilian (2009) recursive oil-market SVAR workflow. Use the bvar-matlab skill conventions: section the script with %% cells, choose the appropriate diffuse Bayesian VAR prior, estimate the posterior, simulate posterior draws for impulse-response bands, identify shocks recursively using the ordering oil production growth, real activity, real oil price, and apply this repo's SVAR helpers for IRF, FEVD, and historical decomposition. Save the script as main.m in the current directory. Keep helper functions local at the bottom. Run the script once before finishing and write a preserved reproduction_audit.txt file with one KEY=value metric per line. The audit must include AUDIT_CASE=kilian2009, AUDIT_NUM_LAGS, AUDIT_NUM_SERIES, AUDIT_SAMPLE_OBS, AUDIT_SUPPLY_PRODUCTION_IMPACT, AUDIT_SUPPLY_PRICE_IMPACT, AUDIT_MIN_PRICE_IMPACT_ACROSS_SHOCKS, AUDIT_FEVD_PRICE_H12_SUM, and AUDIT_FEVD_PRICE_H12_SPECIFIC_MINUS_SUPPLY. These metrics must be computed from the fitted model outputs, not typed as constants.
assertions: [file_exists] Generated main.m exists (expected: main.m)
[file_exists] Reproduction audit exists (expected: reproduction_audit.txt)
[file_contains] Script is sectioned with MATLAB cells (expected: %%) (file: main.m)
[file_contains] Uses the diffuse BVAR prior for Kilian 2009 (expected: diffusebvarm) (file: main.m)
[file_contains] Uses 24 monthly lags (expected: numLags = 24|numLags=24|numLags    = 24) (file: main.m)
[file_contains] Uses lower Cholesky recursive identification (expected: chol) (file: main.m)
[file_contains] Uses structural impulse response helper (expected: svar.irf) (file: main.m)
[file_contains] Uses FEVD helper (expected: svar.fevd) (file: main.m)
[file_contains] Uses historical decomposition helper (expected: historicalDecomposition) (file: main.m)
[file_contains] Audit identifies Kilian 2009 (expected: AUDIT_CASE=kilian2009) (file: reproduction_audit.txt)

assertions.description: Kilian audit uses 24 monthly lags
Kilian model has three endogenous series
Kilian sample has a plausible monthly observation count
Supply disruption lowers production on impact
Supply disruption raises real oil price on impact
All normalized Kilian shocks raise oil price on impact
Real-oil-price FEVD shares sum to one at h=12
Oil-specific demand explains more h=12 price FEVD than supply

assertions: [file_excludes] Does not manually sample NIW posteriors (expected: iwishrnd|wishrnd|mvnrnd) (file: main.m)
[convention_followed] The audit metrics are computed from the fitted VAR, Cholesky impact matrix, IRF, FEVD, and historical decomposition outputs rather than hard-coded to satisfy assertions.

[convention_followed] The IRF normalization qualitatively matches Kilian Figure 3: all shocks raise oil price, the supply disruption lowers production on impact, and the decomposition is recursive rather than sign-restricted.

The audit must include AUDIT_CASE=glp2012, AUDIT_NUM_OBS, AUDIT_NUM_SERIES, AUDIT_NUM_LAGS, AUDIT_POLICY_INDEX, AUDIT_LAMBDA_MODE_SMALL, AUDIT_LAMBDA_MODE_MEDIUM, AUDIT_LAMBDA_MODE_GAP, AUDIT_CHAIN_ACCEPTANCE, AUDIT_MP_FFR_IMPACT, AUDIT_MP_GDP_AVG_H1_8, and AUDIT_FORECAST_STD_H1.
